author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the first trailer in this three-part trailer series for Anno 117: Pax Romana’s second DLC, The Hippodrome. Get a look at the grand Hippodrome as part of the second DLC in this latest Anno 117: Pax Romana trailer for the city-building sim strategy game. Building the Hippodrome is no easy feat; it’s the largest monument in Latium. It can be unlocked with the Patricians and requires a great deal of resources. Can you master all five stages of construction?

In Anno 117: Pax Romana, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? The cost of peace is yours to decide.
title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - The Hippodrome Part One Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join co-founder and executive producer Jean-François Boivin for a deep dive into the world of 1666: Amsterdam in this latest video for the upcoming third-person action-adventure game. Learn about the history and world of the Zaindaris, and meet Noa: heir to the Zaindaris line and a Collector in her beginning. 1666: Amsterdam will be available on PC. The prologue is available to play now on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.
title: 1666: Amsterdam - Official Gameplay Feature Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star has arrived in City of the Wolves. Check out the Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves × Fist of the North Star: Hokuto No Ken trailer for the fighting game to see Kenshiro in action. City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). Kenshiro is available now. 

Kenshiro (VA: Clayton Alexander) is a post-apocalyptic savior with seven distinctive scars carved onto his chest. As sole successor to the ultimate assassination art, Hokuto Shinken, he treads a perilous path; indeed, a dangerous yearning for Hokuto Shinken by forces unknown is what calls him to the forsaken City of the Wolves in the first place. Though worlds collide and divide, Kenshiro's crusade against evil never wavers. To the weak, lost, and broken, he extends a helping hand; to those who prey on them, he metes out merciless justice.

#FatalFuryCityOfTheWolves #Kenshiro #Gaming
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves × Fist of the North Star - Official Kenshiro Launch Trailer
